decision: Use released TypeScript 7.0.2 unstable sync API
why: Published npm package exposes checker operations; stable API unavailable

decision: Store compiler-derived results at callsite spans
why: Runtime assertions should not start a native compiler

decision: Use source-hashed cache with synchronous assertion lookup
why: Detect stale source and mismatched compiler instead of silently passing

decision: Precache with the selected TS7 package and run compiled tests with source maps
why: Keep callsite lookup on original TypeScript source

decision: Neutralize suppression comments in a length-preserving virtual diagnostic project
why: Normal semantic diagnostics hide @ts-expect-error; original project retains context and source positions
evidence: npm test: 5 pass; test/suppressed.test.mjs and test/typed.test.mjs

decision: Expose isolated baseline/candidate native CLI instantiation delta
why: No per-expression counter in TS7 JS API; semantic noEmit CLI result is a distinct algorithm
evidence: npm test: 6 pass; repeated delta and failing compiler test; test/measure.test.mjs

decision: Reject missing and stale cache; retain substring text matches and thrown undefined
why: Silent cache misses and incorrect throws would make passing tests untrustworthy

decision: Match cached call by exact source span rather than previous column on the line
why: A missing second same-line call could reuse the first record
evidence: npm test: 6 pass; test/typed.test.mjs rejects missing same-line record

decision: Check runtime and suppressed compiler errors together
why: Attest exposes throwsAndHasTypeError for correlated failures
evidence: npm test: 6 pass; positive and negative combined assertion in test/typed.test.mjs

decision: Validate the complete JSON cache shape before trusting it
why: Missing source spans previously passed validation through a type assertion
evidence: npm test: 6 pass; malformed-span rejection in test/runtime.test.mjs

decision: Exercise completions and property JSDoc through compiled assertion calls
why: Analyzer-only checks do not verify the serialized runtime API
evidence: npm test: 6 pass; test/typed.test.mjs includes checksEditorData

decision: Document tested TS7.0.2 API and distinguish explicit benchmarks from inline Attest behavior
why: Published compiler API is unstable and unsupported features must remain visible
evidence: npm ci && npm test: 6 pass; packed CLI cached 12 assertions; external consumer import and typecheck pass; npm pack includes README

decision: Require exact call-start offset for cache lookup
why: Overlapping nested spans let an outer cached result impersonate a missing inner call
evidence: npm test: 6 pass; nested positive and missing-inner negative; emoji preceding same-line call
